[1] Ezreal is a simple matchup, you can get into his range easily with your stealth and you should be able to out damage at most points of the game.
[1] Hard To lane against. He outdamages early and longer range with more AS. Try to dodge Qs and not take early fights unless they look good or they make a mistake.
[1] You outscale later  and beat him post 6. Post 6 you destroy him with Q and a good angle to open up.
[1] Desvie de seus Q que não haverá problema jogar contra um Ezreal

[2] He will come at you in stealth, and if he does catches you by surprise you will die since he gets attack speed buff coming out of stealth.
[2] Avoid clumping against a Twitch because his ultimate deals massive damage to targets in a line.
